latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker Arabic — Create Videos with Arabic Text.

- Allows users to upload video clips or images and add Arabic subtitles and right-to-left captions automatically.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; renders videos in about 30-90 seconds.
- Handles cloud setup automatically, including authentication and session management.
- Provides direct commands for uploading, exporting, checking credits, and viewing project state.
- Includes error handling for token expiry, file limits, and export eligibility.
- Designed for Arabic-speaking creators who want captioned videos without complex editing software.
